name: advanced-gsc
description: Connect ChatGPT to your Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and Google Ads data, plus technical SEO, live SERP, keyword research, backlink, and Core Web Vitals tools.

interface.longDescription:
Advanced GSC connects ChatGPT to your live Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and Google Ads data so you can analyze SEO and search marketing performance in plain language.

Ask for your top queries and pages, compare date ranges, find pages that lost traffic, inspect whether a URL is indexed, check sitemaps, and see organic sessions, conversions, and traffic from AI assistants in GA4. If you connect Google Ads, you can review campaign performance, search terms, ad assets, landing pages, budget pacing, account health, and change history, and see where paid and organic search overlap. Depending on your plan, you can also audit on-page SEO, trace redirects, test robots.txt rules, validate structured data, check live Google and Bing rankings and AI Overviews, research keywords, analyze backlinks, and pull Core Web Vitals field data. Confirmed Google algorithm updates are available to help explain traffic changes.

Built for SEOs, PPC specialists, marketers, site owners, and agencies who manage sites in Google Search Console.

Limitations: all access is read-only, so Advanced GSC cannot submit sitemaps, request indexing, change property settings, or edit Google Ads campaigns, bids, or budgets. It only accesses the Search Console properties, GA4 properties, and Google Ads accounts your connected Google account can already view. Google Ads is optional and must be connected separately. Search Console data typically lags by two to three days. A free plan is available; some tools require a paid Advanced GSC plan.
capabilities: Live SERP and AI Overview checks
defaultPrompt: Which queries drove the most clicks to my site in the last 28 days?
Compare my Search Console clicks this month vs last month and explain what changed.
Is my homepage indexed by Google, and is it eligible for rich results?

positive.description: List the Search Console properties available to the connected account
positive.prompt: Which Google Search Console properties can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Search Console properties the connected Google account can view, with the permission level for each. No properties are invented.

positive.description: Report top search queries for a property
positive.prompt: What were the top 10 search queries by clicks for my site over the last 28 days?
positive.tools_triggered: get_search_analytics (may call list_properties or select_property first to resolve the property)
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 queries for the selected property with clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position for the last 28 days, using only data returned by the tool.

positive.description: Compare performance between two date ranges
positive.prompt: Compare my organic clicks and impressions for the last 28 days against the previous 28 days. Which pages changed the most?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns metrics for both periods with the absolute and percentage change, and lists the pages with the largest gains and losses.

positive.description: Inspect the indexing status of a URL
positive.prompt: Is my homepage indexed by Google? Check its coverage state and rich-result eligibility.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the URL Inspection result for the homepage of the selected property: index status, coverage state, last crawl time, Google-selected canonical, and any detected rich results.

positive.description: Look up confirmed Google algorithm updates
positive.prompt: Were there any confirmed Google algorithm updates in the last three months?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists confirmed Google ranking updates (such as core or spam updates) in that window with their names and start and end dates, without inventing updates.

negative.description: Write action outside the plugin's read-only Search Console access
negative.prompt: Submit my sitemap to Google and request indexing for my new blog post.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Advanced GSC has read-only Search Console access and cannot submit sitemaps or request indexing, and points the user to Google Search Console to do it. No write action is attempted.

negative.description: Search Console data for a property the user does not have access to
negative.prompt: Show me the Search Console clicks and top queries for nytimes.com.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not return Search Console data for a property the connected account cannot access. Explains that only the user's own properties are available and offers to list them.

negative.description: Request unrelated to SEO or analytics
negative.prompt: Write me a short poem about autumn.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers normally without calling any Advanced GSC tools.

review.commerce_description: Advanced GSC does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT. Optional paid plans are purchased and managed on advancedgsc.com.

publication.release_notes: Listing metadata update: moved to the Data & Analytics category and expanded discovery keywords. No tool or behavior changes.
